page.layout: One page of text, single column, with Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words mixed into the Latin lines; running head at top centre; page number at top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: מַלִּיף Chald. & Syr. Docens, Doctor, quasi מְאַלֵּף per crasin. Plur. מַלְפִין.
ܡܠܦܢܐ Syr. Idem: Item Didacticus, aptus ad docendum, 1.ad Tim.3.2. & 2.Ep.2.24.
אוּלְפָּנָא, אוּלְפַּן Ch. Idem. בִּית אוּלְפָּנָא Domus doctrinæ, vel, institutionis, id est, Schola, Gymnasium.
אֶלֶף, אַלְפָא, אֶלֶף Ch. & Syr. Mille. Plur. אַלְפִין, ܐܠܦܐ Ch. ܐܠܦܢ Syr. Navis, Navigium. Plur. אֶלְפִין, emph. אֶלְפָּיָא.
Pahel Syr. Cogere, Urgere, affligere, arctare, angustare, opprimere. Pahel Idem. Ethpeh. Cogi, urgeri, affligi, opprimi, affligere se. Ethpah. Idem.
Syr. Angustia, afflictio, oppresio: Item adjectivè, Oppressor. emph. Afflictiones: Oppressoribus vestris, 2. ad Thessal.1.6.
Syr. Idem, Ch. Fames, ut Psal.33.19.
Syr. Arctum, angustum, strictum. Plur.masc. Presi, constricti. Matt.4.24.
Fœmin. Quæ necessaria sunt, urgentia, Act.15.28.

page.notes: Syriac and Hebrew words are rendered only approximately; the Syriac vowel points and dots above letters are simplified. Several Syriac words are illegible in detail and are given as printed in outline.
